parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        $1::varchar AS source_name,
        $2::varchar AS source_platform,
        NULLIF($3::varchar, '') AS query_shop_name,
        $4::varchar AS collection_scope,
        $5::timestamptz AS requested_end_ts,
        $6::integer AS overlap_minutes
),

last_watermark AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(cr.query_end_ts) AS watermark
    FROM voc.collector_runs cr
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE cr.status = 'SUCCESS'
      AND cr.query_end_ts IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.collection_scope = 'INCREMENTAL'
      AND cr.source_name = p.source_name
      AND cr.source_platform = p.source_platform
      AND COALESCE(cr.query_shop_name, '__ALL__')
          =
          COALESCE(p.query_shop_name, '__ALL__')
)

SELECT
    p.source_name,
    p.source_platform,
    p.query_shop_name,
    p.collection_scope,

    lw.watermark AS previous_watermark,

    CASE
        WHEN lw.watermark IS NULL
        THEN date_trunc(
            'day',
            p.requested_end_ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'

        ELSE
            lw.watermark
            - make_interval(mins => p.overlap_minutes)
    END AS query_start_ts,

    p.requested_end_ts AS query_end_ts,

    p.overlap_minutes,

    CASE
        WHEN lw.watermark IS NULL
        THEN 'FIRST_RUN_TODAY_00'
        ELSE 'WATERMARK_WITH_OVERLAP'
    END AS window_reason

FROM params p
CROSS JOIN last_watermark lw;
